corners.name: Original corners
corners.description: The familiar L brackets. A clean reference for every comparison.

rails.name: Light rails
rails.description: Long, fine tracks with small index ticks. Precise and architectural.

bevel.name: Prism cut
bevel.description: Chamfered corners with two illuminated edges. A more sculpted frame.

echo.name: Double exposure
echo.description: Offset corner traces in two tones. A restrained phosphor afterimage.

arc.name: Orbital arcs
arc.description: Open arcs and four quiet alignment ticks. Softer, spacious geometry.

still.name: Immediate
still.description: No entrance effect. The reference for speed and clarity.

sweep.name: Light sweep
sweep.description: A single light line travels down as the image appears. 620 ms.

aperture.name: Split aperture
aperture.description: A diagonal opening expands from the centre. 540 ms.

develop.name: Phosphor develop
develop.description: Soft light resolves into a crisp photograph. 480 ms.

raster.name: Raster build
raster.description: Twelve measured steps reveal the image like a plotter. 600 ms.

relay.name: Ion / Relay
relay.description: Your Ion palette, precise light rails and one clean scan. The strongest starting point.

aperture.name: Prism / Aperture
aperture.description: Faceted light, cut corners and a diagonal reveal. Sharper and more cinematic.

ghost.name: Ion / Ghost
ghost.description: A wider corridor, softer glow and a double trace. More analogue, less insistent.

observatory.name: Orbit / Observatory
observatory.description: Broad silver arcs and quiet image frames. The most restrained of the new mixes.

film.name: Dusk / Film
film.description: Rose light, coarser background texture and an offset frame. A warmer alternative.

plot.name: Blueprint / Plot
plot.description: Drafting lines, indexed rails and a stepped reveal. The most instrument-like direction.
